## About
Star Auto Group sits at 19241 Dix Road in Melvindale. We sell used vehicles, including rebuilt titles, and we'll answer your questions straight so you know what you're looking at.
We also offer financing and car service, and we buy all makes and models. Stop by, ask for Ali, and take your time looking the car over.

## Services
- Find me a vehicle: Tell us what you're after and we'll help you track it down.
- Request car price: Search our inventory and ask for a quote on the vehicle you like.
- Schedule a Test Drive: Pick a car and a time that works for you, then come drive it.
- Financing: We can help with financing on your next vehicle.
- Car Service & Maintenance: Our service department helps keep your car safe on the road.
- We buy all makes and models: Stop by and see us. We buy fast and hassle free.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Do you sell rebuilt title vehicles?
A: Yes. Two reviewers bought rebuilt vehicles from us and were happy with the cars and the work.

Q: What makes and models do you buy?
A: We buy all makes and models. Stop by and see us.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, we offer financing. Give us a call or stop in to talk it through.

## What customers say
- "Saw their ebay listing for a '13 Taurus with a salvage title. VIN search showed the before photos of collision damage from the insurance auction, so I had a pretty good idea of what to look for and where. Having a background in automotive including collision repair helped.

I decided the hour drive was worth a chance to see it, and it was worth the trip.

The place is nothing pretty, which might turn off customers who care about appearances. I met Ali, very kind and personable...not pushy, which is something I appreciate.

Spent a lot of time crawling inside, around and under the car; the repair work was excellent and almost undetectable, even in areas I focused on thanks to the original photos I'd found online.

Test drive showed nothing unusual so I started the negotiating. 6K miles, good repair, purchase price ended up being less than 1/2 sticker. Awesome.

In the end, know what you're looking at, inspect it. Get history if you can like I did. Be kind but firm on negotiations." (Devon Smith, 5/5)
- "Purchased a 22 Explorer ST from star auto, Sight unseen I was extremely nervous knowing it was a rebuilt vehicle and I'm very picky and almost never satisfied with anything other that factory paint and body work. They were very open and willing to provide before pictures of damage and a full detailed report of all parts and work performed. Well two days later it showed up at my home and instantly relieved the vehicle was beautiful the work was top notch! I have went over the vehicle multiple times and I'm blown away with the quality and the paint match and blend that was done I received a practically new suv for a fraction of new price. Again thank you we'll definitely be doing more business in the future." (Justin Cox, 5/5)
